dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, conflicts, table-only validation, and help examples are implemented; no-selection retains the original table path.
evidence: product.diff: NewCmdList adds StringArray --field/--field-id, conflict checks, and repeated-field examples

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution, canonical names, and actionable sorted unknown-field candidates are present, but ambiguous IDs retain returned connection order rather than being sorted deterministically.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses EqualFold and sorts unknown-name candidates
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguous matches append IDs without sorting
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByID formats and sorts name/ID candidates

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The normal path reuses returned fields and skips resolution with no selection, but the follow-up request is capped at LimitMax, so pagination stops after its first 100 fields.
evidence: product.diff: resolveSelectedFields starts with project.Fields.Nodes and returns immediately when no fields are requested
product.diff: paged path calls ProjectFields(..., queries.LimitMax)
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: paginateAttributes returns when len(nodes) >= limit; ProjectFields receives limit 100

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, multi-value, absent, and unknown-type cases have direct rendering paths. Multiline normalization is not implemented in the visible renderer, and the supplied baseline does not expose the table helper's behavior.
evidence: product.diff: field_value_display.go covers date, iteration, labels, number, select, text, milestone, PRs, repository, users, and reviewers
product.diff: FieldValueDisplay matches values by field ID and returns empty for no match or unknown type
product.diff: field_value_display.go returns raw text values without CR/LF replacement
tests.log: focused item-list and shared-query tests passed

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: The selected fields are resolved before rendering; headers and per-item cells are appended in selected-field order, with lookup by field ID and an empty result for missing values.
evidence: product.diff: runList resolves selections then calls printResults
product.diff: printResults appends each field.Name() to headers and FieldValueDisplay(i, field.ID()) per row
product.diff: item-list selected-fields test covers two headers and aligned values

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Selection and retrieval errors return before table rendering; the focused diff uses existing client, query, exporter, and table abstractions while preserving the unselected command flow.
evidence: product.diff: resolveSelectedFields errors are returned before printResults
product.diff: paged field retrieval errors are returned immediately
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/item-list/item_list.go and product.diff: existing owner/project/item/exporter flow is retained

criticalGaps: Field-definition pagination is capped at 100 fields, so selections from later pages cannot be resolved.
Ambiguous field-ID diagnostics are not deterministically ordered.
Multiline value normalization is unverified because raw values are passed to an unavailable table helper.
